newsitem.title: TANZANIA: South African defence chief arrives in Tanzania.
newsitem.headline: South African defence chief arrives in Tanzania.

text.p: South African chief of defence forces General George Meirring arrived in Tanzania on Sunday for a four-day official visit, his second trip to Tanzania within six months.

"General Meirring is here to discuss military cooperation between the two countries," South African Ambassador Thandi Lubaje-Rankoe told Reuters. The main area of cooperation is military training, Van Schalkwyk said.
Meirring, arriving in a South African airforce plane, was met at Dar es Salaam airport by his Tanzanian counterpart, General Robert Mboma.
South African defence attache Colonel Tienie Van Schalkwyk earlier told Reuters the two forces, enemies in the apartheid era, were now close friends.
General Meirring is to pay a courtesy call on Zanzibar President Salmin Amour. Zanzibar has a semi-autonomous status in the United Republic of Tanzania, which links it with mainland Tanzania.
